lastCompletedStory.title: Strengthen the non-falsifiable backoff-bound assertion in the idle-gate timeout test

nextStoryContext: US-003 (CAM-376) replaced the non-falsifiable `recordedSleeps.every((ms) => ms <= 1_000)` assertion at test/dispatch.test.ts:754 (old) with a locally-derived `POLL_INTERVAL_MS` const and a strict-equality assertion `recordedSleeps.every((ms) => ms === POLL_INTERVAL_MS)`, following the derive-don't-freeze idiom from US-002 in this same PR (the const feeds BOTH the pollIntervalMs override and the assertion, so they cannot drift apart). This is a strengthening only: the enclosing test's other assertions (sendKeysCalls length 1, geometrySamplerCalls === 0, exactly one push-undelivered event, stderr warning content) are untouched, and src/tmux/dispatch.ts is byte-identical to main (verified via diff). test/dispatch.test.ts grew 823->838 lines (file-size-budget.json ceiling raised accordingly, _ref prepended citing CAM-376/US-003, staged). A new patterns.md bullet (after the CAM-377 derive-don't-freeze bullet at :903) documents the general technique for proving an in-test assertion (as opposed to a shell oracle) is falsifiable: inject a synthetic value of the suspect shape directly into the recorded collection under test, confirm the new assertion goes red and the old one would have stayed green on the identical mutated data, then revert before committing. No remaining stories in this PRD depend on this one; this closes out CAM-376's three-story arc (US-001 durable-pointer fix, US-002 derive-don't-freeze rule, US-003 this falsifiability strengthening).

officialDocsValidated.summary: Falsifiability mutation (US-003, CAM-376): temporarily added `recordedSleeps.push(300)` (a backoff-shaped value: computeBackoffMs default base=300, streak=1, zero jitter) immediately after the idle-gate-timeout sendKeysVerified call in test/dispatch.test.ts, before the assertions, then reverted before commit. MEASURED (not argued): on the resulting array [1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,300], the OLD bound `recordedSleeps.every((ms) => ms <= 1_000)` evaluated to true (verified via `bun -e`, a standalone re-evaluation of the exact old expression against the exact mutated array), confirming the old assertion was vacuously passing. `bun test test/dispatch.test.ts` under the live mutation (with the NEW assertion `recordedSleeps.every((ms) => ms === POLL_INTERVAL_MS)` in place of the old one) exited 1 (34 pass / 1 fail, the targeted test failing exactly at the new assertion line). retryBaseMs itself is a destructuring default inside sendKeysVerified's options bag (src/tmux/dispatch.ts:544) and could not be exercised by passing it explicitly here, because the idle-gate-timeout path (waitForIdlePane returning timedOut=true) never reaches computeBackoffMs at all -- sendOnceUnverified is called directly, skipping the retry/backoff loop entirely -- so the approved alternative from the story notes (inject a backoff-shaped value directly into recordedSleeps) was used instead. After reverting the `recordedSleeps.push(300)` line, `bun test test/dispatch.test.ts` exited 0 (35 pass / 0 fail), and the full `bun test` suite (5192 pass / 0 fail) and `bun run check:all` both passed clean.
